main_text.l: CUm a Serenissimo Rege Navarreno ad V. Celsitudinem ablegatus fuerim, Illustrissime & Clementissime Princeps, antequam in ipsius Aulam me conferrem, Illustrissima Celsitudini V. adventum meum per literas indicare volui, ut his veluti Pararii ad Illustriss. Celsitudinem V. bona cum ipsius gratia mihi pateret aditus. Quanquam ea sit hujusce Legationis causa, ut vel optimi Regis pietate, vel rei ipsius utilitate, Celsitudinis V. benevolentiam citra commendationem ullam promeritura sit, tamen ut hanc Epistolam scriberem itineris mei praeviam Illustriss-

page.notes: The initial C is a large woodcut letter, joined to "Um" as "CUm". Words such as "Pararii" and "Illustriss." are as printed. Several words in the lower lines are partly damaged; "Celsitudinem" and "ipsius" are read with [?] where uncertain. Catchword at foot: "Illustriss-" is a line end, not a catchword.
